name: ad.search
description: Google responsive search ad quality for a local B2B service. Input: the ad's headlines, descriptions, sitelinks, target query and the landing page's first-screen facts (H1, offer, CTA) so message match can be judged.

ad_query_match.instructions: Do the headlines echo the likely search query (service plus location) the ad targets? (family I, weight 3)
criteria: Exact query language first, with location and buyer type across variants

ad_named_pain.instructions: Does the ad name a specific pain or failure the searcher has right now? (family I, weight 3)
criteria: Specific failure in the buyer's words
Failure and consequence for this buyer type
The searcher feels named in one line

ad_finished_outcome.instructions: Does the ad promise a finished, checkable outcome rather than a tool or feature? (family I, weight 3)
criteria: Outcome with a check or acceptance
Outcome, acceptance and a timing shape
Concrete, checkable finished result stated plainly

ad_specificity.instructions: How specific is the copy (numbers, named deliverables, scope) versus generic? (family I, weight 2)
criteria: Every line carries a specific, verifiable detail

ad_price_or_entry.instructions: Does the ad signal price, a free first step, or the entry route so clicks are pre-qualified? (family I, weight 2)
criteria: Free step plus a priced next step
Clear ladder: free check, then a priced review
Transparent entry and price that pre-qualify the click

ad_trust_signal.instructions: Does the ad carry a credible trust signal (named person, local presence, method, proof) without unsupported claims? (family I, weight 2)

ad_differentiation.instructions: Would this ad stand out among typical competitor ads for the same query? (family I, weight 2)
criteria: Unmistakably different and more useful than its neighbours

ad_cta_prequalify.instructions: Does the call to action say exactly what happens next and filter out poor fits? (family I, weight 2)
criteria: Action plus who it is for
Action that filters out the wrong buyers
Precise next step, cost and fit in one line

ad_message_match.instructions: Does the landing page restate the ad's promise in its first screen (message match)? (family I, weight 3)
criteria: H1 and first call to action match
Same words, same offer, same price
Seamless: ad headline, H1, offer and call to action identical in substance

ad_policy_safety.instructions: Is the ad free of claims that risk disapproval or mislead (guarantees, unsupported superlatives, invented statistics)? (family I, weight 2)
criteria: Every claim verifiable on the landing page

ad_asset_coverage.instructions: How complete and varied is the asset set (headline variety, descriptions, sitelinks, callouts)? (family I, weight 1)

ad_local_relevance.instructions: Does the ad make local relevance (Denver, Colorado) concrete for a local buyer? (family I, weight 1)
criteria: Local person with an in-person option

rules.reason: risky or unsupported claim in ad copy
landing page does not restate the ad promise
